title: Never Stop Thinking: Continuous-Time Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice agents built on LLMs follow a rigid listen-think-speak loop that inserts seconds of dead air before every reply. We show that continuous-time cognition (thinking while listening and thinking while speaking) emerges from an unmodified text model under a lightweight interrupt-and-resume orchestrator, cutting live-pipeline latency by 19% overall and by half in the regime the mechanism targets. To measure whether continuous-time thinking improves what agents accomplish, we introduce ReactiveBench: 120 interactive scenarios scored against pre-registered binary requirements, plus a verifiable streaming track scored by exact correctness. ReactiveBench exposes a pitfall with broad consequences: LLM judges reward visible reasoning; a large judged "advantage" of continuous-time thinking reverses sign under an independent judge, and judge-trained models objectively complete fewer requirements when they think. A five-stage training study then

translated_title: 永不停歇的思考：连续时间语言智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的语音智能体遵循僵化的“听-思-说”循环，在每次回复前会插入数秒的空白停顿。我们展示了连续时间认知（边听边思考、边说边思考）可以在一个未经修改的文本模型上，通过轻量级的中断-恢复编排器得以涌现，将实时管线的整体延迟降低了19%，并在该机制所针对的场景中实现了延迟减半。为了衡量连续时间思考是否能改善智能体的实际任务完成情况，我们提出了ReactiveBench：包含120个交互场景，根据预先注册的二元需求进行评分，另设一个可验证的流式赛道，按精确正确性评分。ReactiveBench揭示了一个影响广泛的陷阱：LLM裁判会奖励可见的推理过程；连续时间思考在LLM裁判下的显著“优势”，在独立裁判下会发生符号反转，且经过裁判训练的模型在思考时客观上完成的需求反而更少。一项五阶段训练研究随后（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出通过轻量级中断-恢复编排器使未修改的文本LLM实现连续时间思考（边听边想、边说边想），将语音智能体延迟降低19%，并发布ReactiveBench基准揭示LLM裁判会奖励可见推理从而高估连续时间思考的真实收益。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that continuous-time thinking (thinking while listening and speaking) emerges from an unmodified text LLM via a lightweight interrupt-and-resume orchestrator, cutting voice agent latency by 19%, and introduces ReactiveBench, which reveals that LLM judges overreward visible reasoning and overstate the benefits of continuous-time thinking.
